policy_grid.other_readouts: read existing all-readout report only; no extra policy traces

ranking.primary: for candidate final 10m linear-average, sum each exact information row's saved-prefix additive unilateral best-response loss across both responding seats, divide by two for NashConv/2, average over all three seeds, descending; tie by exact information index
ranking.zero_support: retain and report counts but exclude zero saved-prefix reach from top examples
ranking.street: TURN for four observed board cards, RIVER for five
ranking.collision: count exact information rows mapping to each candidate abstract row by street; do not use collision count alone as a gain

estimands.additive_contribution: half of each trace_losses saved-prefix loss in chips; sums over exact rows and both responding seats to saved-policy exact restricted-game exploitability
estimands.alternative_action_values: counterfactual action chips for the responding seat against the fixed saved opponent with own best-response continuation after the action; hidden histories combined before maximization
estimands.local_diagnostic: saved-continuation counterfactual action values at selected rows only; no independent action interventions or additive game-loss claim
estimands.reach: report both chance times opponent reach before maximization and full saved-prefix reach used in the additive contribution

failure_rule: retain partial output, stop; no training, scientific retry, cap change, spot swap or candidate change
publication: publish this plan before running diagnostic ranking; publish tested isolated diagnostic source before the one read-only run; retain raw rows and a reproducible report; keep PR draft while failed acceptance and final local qualification remain unresolved
